headword: {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}

definitions.explanation: A person who works at a post office, handling mail services, package delivery, and related financial services.

examples.japanese: {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}に{荷物|にもつ}を{預|あず}けた。
examples.english: I handed the package to the postal clerk.

examples.japanese: {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}が{窓口|まどぐち}で{丁寧|ていねい}に{対応|たいおう}してくれた。
examples.english: The post office worker helped me courteously at the counter.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}{郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}として{働|はたら}いていた。
examples.english: My grandfather worked as a post office worker when he was young.

notes:
A compound of {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく} (post office) and {員|いん} (member; employee). In Japan, post offices ({郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}) are operated by Japan Post and provide not only mail and parcel services but also banking (ゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}) and insurance (かんぽ{生命|せいめい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}に{聞|き}く: to ask a postal clerk
- {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}として{働|はたら}く: to work as a postal worker
- {窓口|まどぐち}の{郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}: the clerk at the counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {郵便配達員|ゆうびんはいたついん}: mail carrier; postal delivery person — specifically the person who delivers mail to homes
- {局員|きょくいん}: office worker; staff member — generic term for an employee at a bureau or office
- {配達員|はいたついん}: delivery person — broader term covering any delivery service
